entities.summary: Giovanni Di Stefano is an Italian-British businessman and convicted fraudster. He has been involved in legal cases for high-profile and notorious defendants worldwide. He has no legal qualifications, is barred from working in law in the UK, and is not registered to work as an advocate in the UK or Italy. He has been referred to as "The Devil's Advocate" for his claimed advocacy on behalf of such notorious clients as Saddam Hussein and Slobodan Milošević. He was also a business associate of Željko Ražnatović, a Serbian paramilitary leader and indicted war criminal.
